name: Zhou Mingrui
role: Original consciousness and memory-root that awakens in Klein Moretti's body.
sourceNote: Chapter 1 names Zhou Mingrui, then shows Klein Moretti's memories flooding into him and his recognition of the body as Klein.

name: Klein Moretti
role: Primary embodied identity in Tingen and the lasting emotional, familial and moral anchor behind every later persona.
sourceNote: Chapter 1 establishes the Klein Moretti body and memories. Chapters 1–213 form the primary public Tingen era; Klein remains the core self afterward.

name: The Fool
role: Mysterious identity above the gray fog used to preside over the Tarot Club while concealing Klein's real level and circumstances.
sourceNote: Chapter 6 establishes the deliberate mysterious-host performance; Chapter 7 explicitly introduces the code name The Fool.

name: Sherlock Moriarty
role: Backlund private-detective identity used for investigations, commissions and entry into the local Beyonder underground.
sourceNote: Chapter 215 introduces the fake name to Mrs. Sammer; Chapter 216 publicly advertises Sherlock Moriarty as a private detective. Chapters 215–482 are the primary era before the sea identity takes over.

name: The World
role: A controlled Tarot Club persona that lets Klein trade, request information and issue missions without compromising The Fool's divine image.
sourceNote: Chapter 263 creates and names the fake member The World; Chapter 264 brings the persona into a Tarot Gathering.

name: Gehrman Sparrow
role: Cold, dangerous adventurer and bounty-hunter identity designed for the Five Seas, pirate hunting and Faceless-era performance.
sourceNote: Chapter 483 shows identification documents obtained through Sharron's circle naming him Gehrman Sparrow. Chapters 483–732 are the primary sea-era run, although the name is reused later.

name: Dwayne Dantès
role: Mature tycoon persona built to penetrate Backlund high society, Church circles and investment networks while pursuing higher-level investigations.
sourceNote: Chapter 732 already shows Klein obtaining the new black-market identity and documents bearing Dwayne Dantès; Chapter 733 explains the tycoon cover design and Chapter 737 marks the official public appearance.

name: Merlin Hermes
role: Named wandering Miracle Magician identity used to fulfill wishes, leave miracles behind and act as a Miracle Invoker in the real world.
sourceNote: The unnamed wandering-magician acting phase begins in Chapter 1276. Klein explicitly gives the public name Merlin Hermes in Chapter 1290.
